cv.name: Pham Bui Nam Phuong
cv.objective: **Software Engineer** with **2+ years** building web apps in **C#/.NET, Python and TypeScript**, including 15 months as the main contributor to a production CRM (login cut from **~60s to ~5s**). Available immediately.

bullets.text: Altus BackOffice, a CRM and booking platform (.NET 5, EF Core, MySQL, Angular 12): **457 of 1,009 commits**.

Cut reported login time from **~60s to ~5s** by replacing full role-permission token hydration with **per-user, per-screen permission loading** behind a feature flag (C#/ASP.NET Core, Angular); shipped in v5.35.1.

Wrote the workflow engine for an internal AI content tool (FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, React) with DAG scheduling, versioned releases, token auditing and a RestrictedPython sandbox; its **15 production workflows** cut article drafting from **~5 hours to under 1 hour**.

Building a **read-only .NET 9 gateway** that lets AI clients query BackOffice data through a hand-written MCP server and GraphQL (HotChocolate): **OAuth 2.1 with PKCE** and token rotation, writes blocked at the DbContext, rate limits. Lab stage.

Added a **slow-query monitor** (EF Core interceptor feeding a Vue 3 + ECharts dashboard) and moved activity-log writes off the request path onto **RabbitMQ**, with a background-job fallback when the broker is down.
**Synced proposals both ways** between the BackOffice and the sales team's Supabase app (v5.37.1).
Moved homepage profile search to **Algolia**, built **translation screens** for categories, locations and FAQs, and split sitemap export into configurable batches (ASP.NET Core, Angular).

Built the **NEEC site (neec.vn)** end to end: Express + Prisma APIs on MySQL/MariaDB with JWT auth, uploads and Swagger, plus **Vue 3 CMS** screens with CKEditor, article-tag management and filtered search.
Packaged server, website and database in Docker with health checks; backend deploys finish in **under 2 minutes**.

projects.projectName: Delivery Dispatch and Routing System (Graduation Thesis)

bullets.text: **Led a student team** building a logistics platform: API gateway plus user/auth, zone/routing, parcel/session and messaging services (Spring Boot, Node.js/TypeScript, Vue, Keycloak, Docker Compose) and Android driver apps.

Wrote most of the backend and web side outside Android: **OSRM route generation** on local map data, management screens with filtering and pagination, ticket handling, and fixes to the parcel/session flow.
